Then my other roommate picked the room upstairs, and the third roommate ended up with the smallest room downstairs, which also has her own bathroom. She wasn't too happy about it because it's the smallest and the location isn't ideal, but she settled because she has her own bathroom. Now, the roommate downstairs has a really weird work schedule. Sometimes she works nights, sometimes mornings. Some days she works only five hours, and other days she works thirteen hours. Because of this, her sleep schedule is all over the place, and we never know when she's asleep. Since I can't guess when she's sleeping, I often go downstairs to the kitchen to make food and play music on my speaker while I meal prep. This is part of my routine throughout the day, and I really enjoy it since I don't work until 2 pm. But yesterday, my roommate downstairs texted our group chat and asked us to please stop playing music in the kitchen at any time of the day. She said it wakes her up almost every time, and when she's awake, it's just very disruptive. My other roommate agreed with her, but I said that's not really fair because she often plays music too in the kitchen. I told her it wasn't really fair that she had the shittiest room in the house and that if I wanted to switch with her so she wouldn't have to be woken up by it, that would be fine.
